description: Required/optional field schema for Nigerian full-service event planning SMEs.

required_fields.label: Event Type
clarifying_question_templates: What kind of event are you planning?

required_fields.label: Guest Count
clarifying_question_templates: Roughly how many guests are expected?

required_fields.label: Venue / Location
clarifying_question_templates: Do you have a venue in mind, or do you need help sourcing one?

required_fields.label: Budget Range
clarifying_question_templates: What budget are you working with for this event?

optional_fields.label: Event Theme
clarifying_question_templates: Do you have a theme or aesthetic in mind?

optional_fields.label: Vendors Already Booked
clarifying_question_templates: Have you already booked any vendors (caterer, DJ, photographer)?

field_completeness_rules.notes: All required fields must be present before a quote can be computed.

ambiguity_handling.note: Treat vague guest count as missing.
